sources.entry: OpenCore Legacy Patcher - OpenCore Legacy Patcher is a tool for installing new MacOS versions on legacy macs.

summary.one_liner: A Python-based tool that uses Acidanthera's OpenCorePkg and Lilu to install and run newer macOS versions (Big Sur through Tahoe) on unsupported or legacy Macs.
summary.what_it_does: The project builds on OpenCorePkg and Lilu to let Macs that Apple no longer supports run macOS Big Sur and newer, per the README as far back as 2007 models. It lists support for Big Sur, Monterey, Ventura, Sonoma, Sequoia and Tahoe, and says it covers Penryn and newer Macs. Listed features include native over-the-air system updates, WPA Wi-Fi and Personal Hotspot on BCM943224 and newer chipsets, and graphics acceleration for both Metal and non-Metal GPUs. It also claims to unlock Sidecar and AirPlay to Mac on native Macs, and to enable SATA and NVMe power management on non-Apple storage. The README says only clean installs and upgrades are supported, and that existing macOS installs patched by other tools cannot be used. The README points to an in-depth guide for getting started and to a community Discord for help.
use_cases: install a newer macOS on an unsupported Mac
keep an old Intel Mac receiving macOS updates
run macOS Sequoia or Tahoe on a 2007-2017 Mac
restore Wi-Fi or Touch ID on older Macs
enable Sidecar or AirPlay to Mac on unsupported hardware
build and run the patcher from source
how_to_run: See the in-depth OpenCore Legacy Patcher Guide linked in the README for installation steps
To run from source, see the 'Build and run from source' document linked in the README
notable: Targets Macs Apple no longer supports, from 2007 models onward, with macOS Big Sur through Tahoe
Native over-the-air system updates after patching
Patch sets for specific GPUs, Wi-Fi cards and T1 security chips, credited to multiple contributors
Can run from source as well as a packaged tool
caveats: Only clean installs and upgrades are supported; installs patched by other patchers such as Patched Sur or bigmac cannot be used
Official support covers Big Sur through Tahoe; older OSes may work but Dortania provides no support for them, and Mojave and Catalina are directed to dosdude1's patchers
Provided on an AS-IS basis with no support guarantee; help comes from a community-maintained Discord
keywords: install newer macos on old mac
